title: Headings and paragraphs
learningObjectives: Choose semantic text elements and inspect their browser output

understand.concept: Headings: h1–h6 express a document outline; paragraphs group prose. Choose heading levels by hierarchy, not by default visual size.
understand.whyItMatters: Use one clear page heading, then nested section headings; do not skip levels just to change appearance.
understand.analogy: A book uses headings, paragraphs and notes for different purposes; HTML gives those roles explicit structure.
understand.analogyLimit: The book analogy is a memory aid; a browser parses HTML according to defined rules.

explain.narrative: Headings: h1–h6 express a document outline; paragraphs group prose. Choose heading levels by hierarchy, not by default visual size.

examples.expectedOutput: The browser displays the corresponding heading, paragraph, inline formatting or text structure.
